meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 读取当前仓库所有未关闭 issue 与 PR,逐项分类并为每项启动一个后台分析任务,生成带 GitHub 永久链接证据的报告文件到 /tmp/日期时间/。全程只读,不对 GitHub 做评论、合并、关闭或贴标签。
howto.when: 当你说出“triage”“triage issues”“github triage”等关键词,或要求对当前仓库做只读分诊分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个仓库的 issue 和 PR 都 triage 一遍
say.note: 读取全部未关闭条目,逐项产出报告文件

say.text: 只 triage issues,不要动 PR
say.note: 只分析 issue,每个 issue 生成一份报告

say.text: 用 github triage 看看这个仓库
say.note: 全仓分诊,结论写入 /tmp 下新文件夹

howto.what_en: Reads all open issues/PRs, classifies each, and spawns one background subtask per item to write Markdown reports with GitHub permalink evidence into /tmp/{timestamp}/. Read-only: never comments, closes, merges, or labels.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say “triage”, “triage issues”, “github triage”, etc., or ask for a read-only triage analysis of the current repository.

say_en.text: Triage all issues and PRs in this repo
say_en.note: All open items are analyzed into report files
Only open issues get individual reports

say_en.text: Run github triage on this repo
say_en.note: Reports land in a new /tmp timestamp folder
